summary: Quetta Acquisition Corporation, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting a $60,000 deposit into its trust account to extend the deadline for an initial business combination by one month, from July 10 to August 10, 2026. No merger target, price, or terms are disclosed. This is a routine extension payment to maintain SPAC status. The filing contains no transaction details, board recommendation, or advisor. Watch for any future business combination announcement before the extended deadline; failure to close could lead to liquidation.
